2607.08605.title: When Structured Sparse Autoencoders Learn Consistent Concepts Across Modalities
2607.08605.paper_summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising technique for mechanistic interpretability by learning a set of sparse latent features in large models, each of which encodes a distinct concept. However, in vision-language models (VLMs), vanilla SAEs struggle to learn modality-consistent concepts, with concepts often exhibiting fragmented coverage (i.e., disjoint regions) in the visual modality. To address this challenge, we propose a Structured Sparse AutoEncoder ($S^2AE$) that enforces concept consistency from both semantic and spatial perspectives in the visual modality. Specifically, we group image patches based on Transformer attention similarity and spatial proximity, and introduce a structured sparsity regularization when training the vanilla SAE. The regularization consists of exclusive sparsity for inter-group concept disentanglement and group sparsity for intra-group concept consistency, which drives the latent neurons by SAEs to specialize in distinct, semantically grounded concepts. Evaluated on the \texttt{Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct} model, the method achieves 6.06% average improvement in semantic alignment (mIoU) and 60.81 in representational efficiency (lower l0 norm) while maintaining near-perfect reconstruction fidelity with an Explained Variance above 99%. Cross-modal analysis further demonstrates that $S^2AE$ enhances neuronal monosemanticity by this visual structural prior, achieving a 3.08% average gain in semantic consistency and a 2.37% average gain in monosemanticity scores for both modalities of multimodal features, thereby fostering more coherent and disentangled representations.
2607.08605.paper_summary_zh: 稀疏自編碼器（SAEs）已成為通過學習一組稀疏潛在特徵來實現機械解釋性的有前景技術，這些特徵在大型模型中，每個特徵編碼一個獨特的概念。<lb/>然而，在視覺-語言模型（VLMs）中，普通的 SAEs 難以學習模式一致的概念，這些概念在視覺模式中往往表現出片段式的覆蓋（即，不相交的區域）。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了一種結構化稀疏自編碼器（$S^2AE$），該模型從語義和空間兩個角度強化視覺模式中的概念一致性。<lb/>具體而言，我們根據 Transformer 注意力相似性和空間接近性對圖像補丁進行分組，並在訓練普通 SAE 時引入結構化稀疏正則化。<lb/>該正則化由互組概念解耦的排他性稀疏性和組內概念一致性的組稀疏性組成，這促使 SAEs 的潛在神經元專注於獨特的、語義上有根基的概念。<lb/>在 \texttt{Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct} 模型上評估，該方法在語義對齊（mIoU）上實現了 6.06% 的平均提升，在表徵效率（較低的 l0 範數）上達到 60.81，同時保持近乎完美的重建保真度，解釋變異數超過 99%。<lb/>跨模態分析進一步表明，$S^2AE$ 通過這種視覺結構先驗增強了神經元的單義性，在多模態特徵的兩種模式中實現了 3.08% 的平均語義一致性增益和 2.37% 的平均單義性分數增益，從而促進了更連貫和解耦的表徵。
